dct_description_sm:
This survey was created to address the current library needs and usage of the graduate students at Memorial University of Newfoundland and Labrador.
Questions covered both general and specific services and resources offered by the different libraries, as well the website, technology, spaces, and social media. 
The survey was created and distributed through Qualtrics and recruitment occurred via social media geared towards MUN graduate students.
dct_title_s: Graduate Students Library Needs Assessment Survey Data
